title: Trapeze - Long Panel
seoTitle: Trapeze Metal Roof - Durable, Eco-Friendly & Low Maintenance
description: Discover durable trapeze metal roofing perfect for cottages and commercial projects. Request a free quote for energy efficiency and long-lasting performance.

sections.text: Trapeze can be installed over existing shingles. Trapeze is a simple sleek option which can be custom cut to suit any home or commercial building needs. A Trapeze roof is close match to the look of a Standing Seam roof (Can also be used for siding).

sections.html:
A trapeze metal roof profile is a great alternative to standing seam roofing suitable for cottages, commercial buildings and farms. Stellar’ trapeze roofing systems are made from sustainable metal materials with a 55-year warranty, therefore lessening your projects carbon footprint. Our panels are gently roll formed not stamped, ensuring the colour coating maintains its integrity. Furthermore, a trapeze style roof is a great option for keeping your property cooler in the summer and warmer in the winter in Toronto.

Trapeze is also more commonly known as T18 or “rib panels”. They are installed vertically up the slop of the roof. This makes a Trapeze roof virtually maintenance free.

At Rudan Roofing, we understand you are looking for an innovative and cost effective alternative to you residential or commercial property. Trapeze panels have exposed fasteners which offer outstanding wind load for any new construction or retrofit project. Plus, trapeze panels made with a 25.5 gauge metal will perform in all types of weather conditions in Toronto, guaranteeing you won’t have to worry about them rusting in inclement weather.

Rudan Roofing systems are produced east of Toronto with Swedish or German metal. Both coil metal manufactures are leaders in high durability metal production. An advantage of a Rudan roof is the metal coils have a thick layer of zinc coating (275g/m2) on both sides of your roofing or cladding. This extra thick zinc coating protects the steel core from corrosion, especially when scratched or cut. The core thickness of the steel is min 0.55 mm- 25 gauge, the thickest in the industry. Metal roofing has become extremely popular due to its naturally attractive appearance and its ability to self repair and avoid corrosion. Our European metal is available in a variety of colours and finishes. Visit our facility to see all of the options available for your metal project.

• Our Trapeze Roof System panels installs more quickly and easily than the typical standing seam metal roofing.
  • The attractive overlapping of the ribs, creating bold clean lines &. making it weather tight roofing.
  • It requires 1/3 number of metal roofing panels and fewer fasteners than the typical standing seam roofing system.
  • The 25 gauge panel can be installed over open purlins, strapping or w/o roof deck, saving material and installation costs.

sections.text: Our Trapeze Roof System panels installs more quickly and easily than the typical standing seam metal roofing. The attractive overlapping of the ribs, creating bold clean lines &. making it weather tight roofing. It requires 1/3 number of metal roofing panels and fewer fasteners than the typical standing seam roofing system. The 25 gauge panel can be installed over open purlins, strapping or w/o roof deck, saving material and installation costs.

The AG Panel also known as the Rib Panel is a lightweight, exposed fastener roofing system that is most popular for agricultural buildings, storage facilities, and canopies. With ease of installation in mind, the AG Panel system is a straightforward installation with clean look and simplicity in mind.

Rudan Tile, modular steel roof panels is an innovative and unique new metal roofing product. The tiles are made of premium G90 steel, with matt crinkle look color coating with strong resistance to abrasion and corrosion. Attractive & elegant appearance combined with top quality make it top choice with architects, contractors and homeowners alike.
